notes.title: Bug Fix Updates
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed

■Fixed the following problems
・Fixed a rare issue where the game process would sometimes remain running after closing the game using the window's "X" button.
・Fixed an issue in the tutorial where "STAGE01" was incorrectly displayed as "PRIMARY1".
・Fixed an issue in STAGE02 Q.7 where the stage could sometimes be cleared even if the drawn object was not inside the ring.
・Fixed a rare issue in STAGE02 Q.11 where the stage could sometimes be cleared even if the solar system was incomplete.
・Corrected some in-game text translations and creator name displays.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
Thank you for your continued support of “Q ｗith VTubers”.
